iniNotFound.title: *.ini files couldn't be loaded.
text: • Start the game first. It will create the missing *.ini files.
• Check if *.ini files exist in C:\Users\[your username]\Documents\My Games\Fallout 76\. They should be called Fallout76.ini and Fallout76Prefs.ini or Project76.ini and Project76Prefs.ini.
• Check your profile settings, especially the advanced section. Are the *.ini path and prefix set to the correct values?
iniNotFound.createIniButton: Create ini files from included template

iniParseError.title: An *.ini file contains invalid syntax and couldn't be parsed.
text: Are the ini files corrupted? Have they been edited? Try one of these options:
• Open the displayed ini file and fix the error if you know how to do it, or
• Start the game and change a few settings, or
• Delete the *.ini files in the folder C:\Users\[your username]\Documents\My Games\Fallout 76\ and then start the game. This will reset all settings to their defaults.
